checks.command: pnpm run guard:wlt-financial-boundary && pnpm run guard:api-binding && pnpm run guard:backend-api-binding && pnpm run guard:frontend-feature-binding
checks.proves: Checks WLT financial ownership and frontend/backend contract bindings.
checks.doesNotProve: Guards do not prove runtime money movement, browser rendering or provider behavior.
checks.passCriteria: All financial/binding guards pass with no surface-local writer or stale contract path.
checks.failCriteria: Any boundary bypass, direct financial writer or unbound feature fails.

checks.command: pnpm --dir apps/control-panel/runtime typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/control-panel/runtime test && pnpm --dir apps/control-panel/runtime build
checks.proves: Checks control-panel types, tests and production build after finance workspace refactor.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove browser authorization behavior or visual correctness.
checks.passCriteria: Typecheck, tests and build pass with canonical finance routes/components.
checks.failCriteria: Compilation, test or build failure fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: test finance navigation/object authorization, maker-checker-executor-reconciler SoD, IDOR, replay, destination masking, export access and audit correlation
checks.proves: Proves finance controls cannot be bypassed through UI/direct requests and sensitive data exposure is bounded.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not replace independent penetration testing.
checks.passCriteria: All forbidden cross-role/cross-context actions are denied and audited; sensitive values remain masked except authorized audited reveal.
checks.failCriteria: Any permission bypass, PII leak, replayed mutation or missing audit evidence fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: on the same candidate run customer top-up, captain top-up/COD/cancel/deliver/earning/payout, partner destination/payout, field commission/destination/payout, and finance batch/execution/reconciliation/close including duplicate/offline/restart/unknown-result scenarios
checks.proves: Proves end-to-end financial journeys and cross-surface readback on representative runtime data.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove production provider/legal readiness unless real approved provider environment is used.
checks.passCriteria: Every scenario converges to the same WLT ledger/state on all affected surfaces with no duplicate effect and correct blocked/error states.
checks.failCriteria: Any surface divergence, duplicate money movement, stale terminal state or unrecoverable exception fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: visually inspect control-panel and all four mobile finance/wallet screens for loading, ready, empty, pending, blocked, forbidden, error, reconciliation-required and completed states
checks.proves: Proves required financial controls/statuses are visible, understandable and do not expose sensitive data.
checks.doesNotProve: Visual inspection does not prove backend authorization or accounting correctness.
checks.passCriteria: All required states/actions are legible, permission-appropriate, masked and linked to canonical readback without obsolete provider-payout UX.
checks.failCriteria: Missing critical state, misleading success, sensitive-data exposure or obsolete payout action fails.
